title: Anachrony
description: A jump in story time over a paragraph or a contiguous range of paragraphs: the narration tells what happened earlier than the story's present (`analepsis`: a flashback, backstory, a past told later than it happened) or what will happen later (`prolepsis`: an announcement). Inside a scene, between scenes or outside any scene. Spans never overlap.

end.description: Last paragraph, inclusive. Absent: the span is the single paragraph `start`.

kind.description: `analepsis`: the narration goes back to an earlier story time. `prolepsis`: it goes forward to a later one.

reach.description: How far it jumps, as the text says it, in the book's language: «años atrás», «when she was a child», «the following spring». Not normalised.
